shared.emailHelp: Only if you'd like a reply. We won't use it for anything else.
shared.notFoundPrompt: Expected something here? <link>Let us know</link> so we can fix the link.
shared.switchHeading: Not the right place? Try one of these instead.

deviceConsent.label: Include my device info to help the team look into this
deviceConsent.items: The page you're on, your browser and device type, your language, screen size and time zone. Never your IP address, your name, or your location.
deviceConsent.note: You can send this form without it.

supportSignpost.heading: Looking for support?
supportSignpost.body: This form reaches the team who build Bloom — not our support team, and it isn't monitored around the clock. If you'd like to talk to someone about your healing or anything you're going through, we're here for you.

success.title: Message sent
success.body: Thank you for taking the time to tell us. We read everything that comes through here.
success.bodyWithEmail: Thank you for telling us. If we have any questions, we'll email you at {email}.
success.bugBody: Thank you for the report. Details like these help us make Bloom more reliable for everyone.

errors.messageRequired: Please add a few words before sending.
errors.feedbackEmpty: Choose an option above, or add a comment so we know what you mean.
errors.emailInvalid: That email address doesn't look right.
errors.submitFailed: We couldn't send your message just now. Please try again in a moment, or <link>email the team directly</link>.

bug.title: Report a bug
bug.intro: Something not working right? Tell us what you saw and we'll look into it.
bug.messagePlaceholder: e.g. I tapped play on a session video and the screen went white
bug.expectedLabel: What did you expect to happen?
bug.stepsLabel: What were you doing just before it happened?
bug.stepsPlaceholder:
1. Opened the library
2. Filtered by 'Courses'
3. Tapped the first card

feedback.title: Share your feedback
feedback.intro: We're always improving Bloom. Tell us how it's working for you — every bit helps.
feedback.tagsLabel: What stood out? Choose any that fit.
feedback.brokeNudge: If something's broken, a <link>bug report</link> helps us fix it faster.
feedback.commentPlaceholder: What's working well, what's frustrating, what you'd love to see…

contact.title: Contact the Bloom team
contact.intro: Have a question, or something to raise about Bloom or your account? Send it here.
contact.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what you'd like to ask or share
